# Agentic Media Lab

> Which skill, renderer and model to use when a coding agent makes your video - with runs you can repeat. Records: 185 (81 tool, 29 model, 75 source, 0 recipe). Concepts: 35. Pages: 4. Size: about 184751 tokens (estimate, characters / 4).

## Entry points

- [Index](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/INDEX.md): concept tree with counts and the hub size
- [Catalog](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/README.md): every record by kind, inactive records listed separately
- [Data schema](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/SCHEMA.md): Use this page when you need the exact record fields, allowed values, id rules or how the evidence badge is derived.
- [Glossary](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/glossary.md): Use this page when a term in the hub is unclear or you need a concept id.
- [All records as JSON lines](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/index/records.jsonl): the full machine dump
- [README.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/README.md): what the hub is
- [AGENTS.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/AGENTS.md): how agents query and extend the hub

## Guides

- [Fact-check results](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/fact-check.md): Use this page when you need to know how far to trust a record's wording, or which research lanes were least accurate.
